summary.text: Ken Clouston is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 32, serving since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ken Clouston was born in Bismarck, North Dakota, and earned a B.S. in physical therapy in 1992 and a doctorate of physical therapy in 2005, both from the University of North Dakota.
Clouston's career experience includes working as a physical therapist.
Clouston assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 2, 2023, succeeding Timothy Hallinan.
For 2025-2026, Clouston serves on the House Labor, Health and Social Services Committee.
